title: Implementation of Vancomycin Powder Application in the Emergency Department for Open Fractures
official: Implementation of Vancomycin Powder Application in the Emergency Department for Open Fractures
summary: To evaluate the feasibility, safety, and potential efficacy of applying vancomycin powder locally to open fractures in the emergency department prior to definitive surgical intervention.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants aged 18 years or older presenting to the Emergency Department with Gustilo-Anderson Type I, II, or III open fractures.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known allergy to vancomycin
* Ballistic open fractures
* Pregnancy
* Currently breastfeeding
* Age younger than 18 years.
